tasks.title: Build the input layer: intents, focus zones, modal traps and platform key tables
tasks.prompt:
Area: input
Critical: yes
Design: docs/design/input.md
Goal: Build the input layer
Title: Build the input layer: intents, focus zones, modal traps and platform key tables
Kind: infra; size: L; area: input.
CRITICAL AREA: build inside the approved design docs/design/input.md; its protected constraints are binding and the task is refused at admission without it.
OLD files to read:
- reference repository: common/constants/keycode.js
- reference repository: mixins/legacy-key-owner.js
- reference repository: plugins/legacy-key-events.client.js
- reference repository: components/ui/GeneralInputComponent.vue
- reference repository: components/ui/RadioGroupComponent.vue
- reference repository: components/PopupVerticalMenuComponent.vue
Target: Implement src/input exactly as the approved design describes: the typed InputManager (intents, normalized input, focus nodes and zones, text input and pointer registrations, modal traps with trigger restoration, virtual focus handoff with generation tokens), the data-driven platform key tables (webOS, Tizen with registerKey, Android TV and Fire TV, desktop), the long-press LONG_SELECT at 800 ms owned by the input layer, hybrid pointer and remote mode with the deadzone, and the useFocusNode hook. Only src/input listens for keys (R-005); the app shell owns start and stop.
Acceptance criteria:
- Every protected constraint D-001 to D-016 of the design is met or its absence is reported as an unmet acceptance criterion.
- src/input has a README.md contract (R-022) and table-driven tests: key tables per platform, spatial ranking, repeat and hold boundaries (799, 800, 801 ms), modal restoration, cleanup of timers and listeners, idempotent disposers.
- No other module in src listens for keys; npm run verify passes including check:design and the legacy build.
- Findings and anything left undone go to docs/migration/findings.md and todo.md.
